message: The other day, I was reminiscing about family road trips before the days of smartphones and endless screens. It’s amazing how much fun we had with just a map and a bit of imagination! 🚗 Rediscovering those simple joys has me thinking about how important it is to be prepared for our journeys, just in case. A little planning can go a long way in making our travels safe and enjoyable. What’s your favorite low-tech travel memory?
